$comment: Log lines scripts/check-logs.mjs accepts. Each entry: pattern (regex), reason (why it cannot be fixed, at least 15 characters), optional logs (e.g. ["test-smoke"]).

entries.reason: VS Code 1.146.0's own AgentHost process calls url.parse() (seen in the Windows smoke run). It is VS Code's code, not FollowAlong's, and the smoke test pins that version.

entries.pattern: ^\(Use `Code --trace-deprecation \.\.\.` to show where the warning was created\)$
entries.reason: Electron's hint line printed after a VS Code-internal deprecation. The deprecation line itself is still checked, so a new one is still caught.

entries.pattern: ^\(Use `exe --trace-deprecation \.\.\.` to show where the warning was created\)$
entries.reason: The same hint line as the entry above, as Linux names the binary ('exe'). It follows the allowlisted [AgentHost:stderr] url.parse() line when VS Code's agent host prints it during the smoke run (seen in CI on Ubuntu). The deprecation line itself is still checked.
